items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'He and Eddie Durham' and the interviewee confirms 'Eddie Durham, that's right' but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: Isn't that something. I found out afterwards Battles was the composer.

Eddie Durham, that's right. And that's how tight Battles and I was for years, and we were together with Willy Bryant as I told you and on just so many things, you know, we were just really hand in hand with him. Just before he died, he had a whole brochure and was about to put on, had a lot of people Singer Sewing Machine people interested in, a woman in authority with Columbia Broadcasting, she was interested in this show that he had written, the music and all of the dialogue and everything.

items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter was playing the alto. Lorenzo Pack and Johnny Russell and Cozy Cole.

ctx.x: Was Benny Carter in it when you --
Benny Carter was playing the alto. Lorenzo Pack and Johnny Russell and Cozy Cole.
